entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The darkened, ugly version of Lorwyn after the Aurora, a world devoid of sun.

entities.name: The Aurora
entities.description: A magical transformation that remade Lorwyn into Shadowmoor and turned boggarts such as Nibb and Gyik feral.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: Paranoid, xenophobic folk living in fortress-like douns and bound by the thoughtweft.

entities.name: Thoughtweft
entities.description: The kithkin mind-bond, tighter and more xenophobic in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Cinders
entities.description: Embittered fire-folk who follow the Path of Sorrow and hunt the Extinguisher.

entities.name: Nighthearth
entities.description: Illulia's cult of murderous cinders who intensify every pain in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Illulia of Nighthearth
entities.description: The cinder leader of the Nighthearth who preaches vengeance on those who wield fire.

entities.name: The Extinguisher
entities.description: A being the cinders believe stole their flame and light from the world.

entities.name: Great Rekindling
entities.description: The cinders' hoped-for restoration of their fire through the sacrifice of the Extinguisher.

entities.name: Kulrath
entities.description: A blasted peak where mounted cinders hunt the Extinguisher.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The queen of the fae who commands armies and bottled the sky one night.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: The faerie realm of Oona, guarded by gatewardens.

entities.name: Merrows
entities.description: Cruel, covetous water folk of the Wanderbrine River and Dark Meanders.

entities.name: Wanderbrine River
entities.description: A river whose murk hides merrow rituals.

entities.name: Dark Meanders
entities.description: A deep water region of merrow wickedness.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Feral marauding gangs who divide the world into things to eat and things to pummel.

entities.name: Nibb
entities.description: A boggart changed by the Aurora from mischief-maker into feral marauder.

entities.name: Gyik
entities.description: A boggart changed by the Aurora from mischief-maker into feral marauder.

entities.name: Wort
entities.description: A boggart gang leader with a raiding-bellow that shatters steel.

entities.name: Scuzzback gang
entities.description: A boggart gang that scavenges rusty armor.

entities.name: Tattermunge gang
entities.description: A boggart gang of frenzied witches.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: Elves of Wilt-Leaf Wood who preserve beauty and fight the darkness.

entities.name: Wilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: The forest of the elves, enclosed by a palisade.

entities.name: Awylla
entities.description: An elvish safewright who tried to forget horrors she had seen.

entities.name: Rhys the Redeemed
entities.description: An elf made whole again in honor and horn.

entities.name: Giants
entities.description: Sleepy, wrathful giantkind.

entities.name: Tollek Worldslayer
entities.description: A giant whose fall caused a corruption to erupt from his corpse.

entities.name: Tarvik Relicsmasher
entities.description: A giant who dreamed trinkets and machines caused all woe, and renamed himself.

entities.name: Treefolk
entities.description: Ancient trees such as Old Ghastbark, with a catastrophe myth.

entities.name: Olka
entities.description: A mistmeadow witch who collected evening mist and can vanish with a thought.

entities.name: Braenna
entities.description: A cobblesmith.

entities.name: Bowen
entities.description: A Barrenton guardcaptain.

entities.name: Warrik Brutehexer
entities.description: A person whose aura favored the depths of the Wanderbrine River.

entities.name: Abral
entities.description: A kithkin alchemist.

entities.name: Grensch
entities.description: A merrow cutthroat.

entities.name: Sygg, River Cutthroat
entities.description: A merrow cutthroat who values the power to take.

entities.name: Hrugash
entities.description: A leech bonder.

entities.name: Taeryn
entities.description: A cinder armorkeep.

entities.name: Dindun
entities.description: A resident of Kulrath Mine.

entities.name: Mowagh the Gwyllion
entities.description: A gwyllion who repurposes scarecrow parts.

entities.name: Roon Ghastbark
entities.description: A speaker on Raven's Run.

entities.name: Raven's Run
entities.description: A haunted place whose ravens no longer cry.

entities.name: Gond
entities.description: A hero of Safehold Taldwen commemorated by a memorial.

entities.name: Safehold Taldwen
entities.description: A safehold of Gond.

entities.name: Gyara Spearhurler
entities.description: A deadly-accurate spear hurler.

entities.name: Rosheen Meanderer
entities.description: A woman who babbles about a bygone sunlit world.

entities.name: The Seer's Parables
entities.description: An in-world text describing godlike beings such as Demigod of Revenge.

entities.name: Pyrtagh Cairn
entities.description: A site now marked by a warning sign.

entities.name: Spinerock Knoll
entities.description: Ruins where witches gathered to study flame.

events.summary: The Aurora transforms Nibb and Gyik from mischief-makers into feral marauders.
events.quote: The Aurora transformed Nibb and Gyik from mischief-makers into feral marauders.

events.summary: When the giant Tollek Worldslayer falls, a corruption erupts from his corpse to carry on his name.
events.quote: When the giant Tollek Worldslayer fell, a corruption erupted from his corpse to carry on his name.

events.summary: The giant Tarvik dreams that trinkets and machines cause all woe and takes the name Tarvik Relicsmasher.
events.quote: When he awoke from his troubled sleep, he took the name Tarvik Relicsmasher.

events.summary: Oona bottles the sky one night and releases it the next after aligning the stars.
events.quote: One night Oona bottled the sky.

events.summary: Olka collects evening mist for years and learns to vanish with a thought.
events.quote: Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

events.summary: Mudbrawler Raiders take directions through the mountains literally.
Witches gather in the ruins of Spinerock Knoll to study the power of flame.
events.quote: Witches tempted by the power of flame gathered to study in the ruins of Spinerock Knoll.

events.summary: A giant uproots a boggart gang's home, and the gang mourns.
events.quote: Their home uprooted by a giant, the gang of boggarts mourned their old stomping ground.

relations.quote: the Nighthearth, Illulia's cult of murderous cinders

relations.note: hunt her for stealing their fire

relations.quote: Those who displease Oona soon learn the extent of the armies she commands.
